epistemic-warrant.definition: Known by reading a sign. The truth is solicited through a procedure (casting, omens, consulting an oracle); a technique of interpretation stands between the knower and the answer.
Known in the body. The warrant is tacit, non-propositional bodily competence: a trained skill or attunement that can be demonstrated but not fully stated.
Known by becoming one with the object. The knower and the known collapse into one.
Direct intellectual apprehension. The truth is grasped whole, without inference and without sensory mediation.
You see it yourself. Direct, unmediated sensory access, with no witness between the knower and the known.
Known through doing it. The warrant is the disciplined activity itself: repeated performance is what makes the claim evident, independent of any bodily skill acquired.
It follows. The warrant is inferential: the claim is licensed by argument, not by access.
It is disclosed. A truth given from outside the natural order, received passively, with no procedure of interpretation standing between the source and the knower.
Someone else tells you. The warrant is mediated: it rests on a living witness who saw, and the knower is not the one who did.

It has been handed down. The warrant is inheritance: the claim is licensed because a tradition, community, or institution holds and transmits it, not because any single living witness saw it. Covers received tradition, communal consensus (ijma, sangha), and institutional authority.

ontological-commitment.definition: The ground is beyond all predication. It cannot be said to be substance, process, or even empty; the fundamental is unsayable.
Awareness is fundamental. Mind is not produced by matter; matter is a content of mind. Mind is the single ground, not a property distributed through things.
One substance under two irreducible aspects; mind and matter are two faces of one ground.
Two or more irreducible kinds are fundamental; no single substance grounds the rest.

The passage actively refuses to commit and holds the refusal as its position. Requires an explicit refusal-marker in the text (this cannot be said; one neither affirms nor denies); absent that marker, code not-asserted.
An impersonal order is fundamental. The ground is a law or pattern, not an agent.
A fallback for the coder: not enough in the passage to judge. Not a position; dropped from the geometry.
Matter is fundamental. What is most real is physical stuff; everything else is its arrangement.
The passage takes no ontological position. It is about ethics or practice and simply does not address what is fundamental. A passive absence.
Experience is a fundamental feature of all things, distributed through matter, not necessarily prior to it.

Reality is constituted through relations of PARTICIPATION — beings are neither identical with ultimate reality (union) nor merely separate substances (dualism/pluralism), but partake in it. Distinct from the substance-based ontology values. Home cases: theosis (2 Peter 1:4, partakers of the divine nature), Ibn Arabi tajalli, Neoplatonic emanation/methexis.
A personal will is fundamental. What is most real is someone, an agent with intention, not an impersonal stuff or law.
Flux is fundamental. What is most real is events and becoming, not fixed things.
Emptiness is fundamental. There is no self-standing substance at bottom; all things are empty of own-being. The emptiness is asserted as the positive claim.

inferential-operation.definition: Infers the best explanation: from a surprising fact, reasons back to what would, if true, make it a matter of course.
Transfers structure from one domain to another: A is to B as C is to D. The conclusion rides on the likeness.
Explains by cause and effect: the conclusion is reached by identifying what produces what.
Deduces from premises already accepted: the conclusion follows necessarily from first principles, regardless of where those principles came from (even if scriptural).
Advances by negation: the conclusion emerges from setting a claim against its contradiction.
Draws the conclusion out of an authoritative text. Bound to recovering a specific source meaning.
Generalises from instances: many observed cases license a claim about the unobserved.

telos.definition: Capability as an end in itself, not as a means.
The aim of ongoing membership and acceptance — having a PLACE with an other or a group, WITHOUT merger (covenant, family, tradition). Distinct from communion (union) and salvation (rescue).
Love, union, belonging. The end is a dyadic bond with an other.
Obedience, duty, worship, preservation. The marker: the end is not the agent own benefit.
The actualisation of persons: a life going well in its own terms.
Right order among parts. The end is the structural relation among many, not a bond with any single one.
Emancipation or reform of a shared world. The end is collective and external, not individual release.
Understanding is the end, not the warrant for something else.
Release. Something binds (craving, ignorance, bondage, structure) and is loosed. The end is freedom from, not the repair of a relation.
Rescue and restoration. Something is wrong or broken, and a right relation is put back.

evaluative-stance.definition: Regards the object as owed good faith: reads for the strongest available sense. An interpretive default, not deference to authority.
Approaches the object as something to resist or stand against — an oppositional posture (Job before God; a prophet before power; a liberation text before authority).

The text's posture toward its object is ironic — it means other than, or against, what it literally says; a detached or subverting attitude. DISTINCT from a stated contradiction (B1 gap-irony) and from an audience-character knowledge gap (Sitz dramatic-irony): this is the STANCE layer only. See three_layer_irony_distinction_s157.
Regards the object without evaluative commitment: describes it without endorsing, discounting, deferring to, or suspecting it.
Regards the object as sacred or authoritative: approached with deference and awe, as something that may make a claim on the reader.
Regards the object as withholding something: reads for what it does not say.
Approaches the object with warmth, care, and protective gentleness — a cherishing, vulnerable regard (distinct from reverent=awe and charitable=good-faith).

hermeneutic-posture.definition: The surface grammatical sense is the meaning. The text means what it plainly says; no hidden layer, symbol, or subtext is sought. A claim about semantic depth, not a refusal to interpret.
Treats the text as an ACT to be enacted/performed (ritual, liturgical, legal, dramatic, sung) — its meaning is in the DOING, not only the interpreting.
The surface hides a mechanism. Digs beneath the text for the real cause or interest it does not declare.
The surface plus. Reads generously, assembles, repairs, seeks what the text can be made to sustain.

r_topology.definition: Living, dead and unborn held as one topology across time; asymmetric yet binding.
The ground makes the world and stays distinct from it. Creator and creature are two, not one.

A party utters, in the first person, words commissioned by an absent principal. The third lends a mouth so an absent party's own voice reaches the addressee — a conduit for VOICE, not a position that stabilises.
One party's capacity to persist, act, or be regulated is structurally contingent on another's support.
Things arise in mutual, symmetric dependence, with no independent ground and no privileged lower level. Nothing stands on its own.
Two parties remain separately bounded and independently capable, without distance or hostility. Kegan self-authorship; Winnicott's external object.
The world flows out of the ground by necessity, through ranked, graded levels of descending reality.
The higher arises from the lower with no prior ground. A directional, bottom-up order.
Nominally distinct parties whose boundaries are insufficiently differentiated. Family-systems codependence.
A party positioned outside a boundary of membership, protection or recognition. The scapegoat position.
Irreversible origination plus mutual obligation flowing in opposite directions; the child chooses the obligation.
Parties occupy unequal positions; authority or permission flows predominantly one way.
The world is the ground. Any difference is apparent; at bottom they are numerically one, with no remainder.
A one-time passage that permanently changes what the parties are to each other.

A third party who, on behalf of one principal, actively presses the other toward restoration. Not neutral, not merely a channel — partisan and pressing. Distinct from mediated-triadic (a third position that STABILISES) and from witness (a third who only observes).
The ground shows itself as the world in one immediate display, with no graded levels; a remainder holds between the hidden ground and its visible appearance.
An A-B relation constituted or stabilised through a third position, object, rule, symbol or witness.
The parties are each constituted AS WHAT THEY ARE through the relation; neither exists prior to it. NOT identity (they remain two) and NOT participation (which presumes pre-existing entities).
Things are real in proportion to how fully they share in the ground. It is about degree of sharing, not rank of level and not identity.
Each party's contribution structurally calls for, and is answered by, the other's. Mutual exchange between parties who remain distinct. NOT dependent-arising, which is causal co-origination.
An asymmetric holding: one party acts on behalf of, or carries responsibility for, another. A POSITION occupied, not a goal pursued.
The relation does not exist prior to its performance; right form constitutes it.
Two parties positioned as competitors for something that cannot be simultaneously possessed.
Owed because of the position occupied, not the personal bond. Owed even if the person is unworthy.
One occupies the subject position; the other is positioned as object, instrument or extension. Buber's I-It pole.
The passage does not specify the relation-shape.

r_condition.definition: Oriented toward union while preserving the distinction between the one who seeks and the one sought. The relation IS the reaching; consummation would end it. Simone Weil's *Waiting for God*; the Psalms' 'my soul waits'; bhakti *viraha* (love-in-separation as devotional discipline); Augustine's restless heart.
Shared presence and mutual formation without absorption.
Shaped by shared suffering plus an active urge to alleviate it.
A freely undertaken bond generating durable, asymmetric-but-reciprocal obligations that persist despite failure.
An originating gift, perpetual gratitude, and an asymmetric indebtedness never fully discharged.
Parties distinct; channels of responsiveness structurally minimised or closed. Avoidant organisation.
Stable balance without clinging or rejection; boundaries permeable, self not dissolved.
Constituted by the ethical demand of the other's vulnerability; self as debtor without reciprocity.
The shape is set by what comportment is appropriate to this particular other.
Asymmetry in which one guides, teaches, or carries responsibility for another.
One provides a bounded field in which another's unmanageable states are borne and returned tolerable.
An asymmetric opening of a boundary that receives the other without dissolving the distinction between them.
A bond maintained through inherited ties across generations; moral permanence.
Each encounters the other as a separate centre of experience while being so encountered.
The relation IS the continuing process of seeking accord; processual, not static.

A relation sustained as non-instrumental mutual PLAY — the interaction is its own point, with no telos, debt, repair, or rescue in view; the freedom of both parties is constitutive. Distinct from communion (presence), reciprocity (exchange), equanimous-nonattachment (affect). Home cases: Vaishnava lila (creation as God's sport), Proverbs 8:30-31 (Wisdom playing/delighting before God), Krishna rasa-lila, Winnicott's play-space.
Asymmetric effort toward mending: provisional trust, testing, restitution. Presupposes a prior whole.
Respond without imposing will: asymmetric but not dominating, responsive rather than generative.
A bond that still exists and is severed. Not the instant of breaking — the sustained condition of being broken while still bound.
A deliberate boundary that halts flow. Not absence — an active cut.
One party holds privileged knowledge of the relation's actual state and transfers it to correct another's mistaken belief about it. The bond is altered EPISTEMICALLY rather than by deed.
The passage does not specify the relation-condition.
Sustained non-coercive attention toward an other who has not yet answered. Distinct from beloved-seeking (which reaches) and from dependence (which is supported): this one holds open without acting.
